data.narrative:
Auriga Space is a Series A–stage space and aerospace company that has raised $12.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 private peers at same or adjacent stages (Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Starcloud at $1.1B Seed) and 5 public-market anchors in the Space & Aerospace sector (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL), which trade at a median 24.6x price-to-sales.

Two methods proved applicable. Stage-Progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $12.2M capital base, implying a valuation of $24M. Peer-Median analysis across the 3 private comparables yields a $1.3B implied valuation, with a range spanning $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-Comp anchoring cannot be applied because target revenue is not disclosed. These two methods triangulate to a range of $21M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $662M.

The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty about Auriga's revenue trajectory and competitive positioning within the sector. The Stage-Progression approach anchors the low end; the Peer-Median approach dominates the central estimate. Resolution of revenue run-rate, customer traction, and technical differentiation versus the peer set would narrow this band substantially.
